integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite direct path tests and an independent star-criterion comparison are in verify_petersen.py. No external independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the Petersen graph only; the known scalar optimum four is previous work. Applies to maximal shortest paths of an unweighted graph; no all-order Kneser or generalized Petersen extension. Indexed-source comparisons are not exhaustive publication-priority clearance.
title: Petersen geodesic-transversal classification: ten minimal sets and a three-spare connectivity threshold
